claims.interface: One exact full rational matrix response to the N68 integer tuple for an NC polynomial over Q with at most s free words; explicit word lengths or complete response bit length charged.
claims.claim: The N68 2s-dimensional full-response decoder reconstructs the NC polynomial; exact aggregation by Parikh vector yields its commutative image and hence a zero test under the free-support promise.
claims.limits: Not polynomial in succinct formula size if the exact response length is exponential. This is not an improvement over the ECCC dimension-s sparse PIT theorem or known deterministic sparse commutative PIT.

claims.interface: One coefficient-independent tuple A in M_d(Q)^n; canonical ordered evaluation; target is every commutative polynomial of total degree at most D over Q; full d-by-d response is returned.
claims.claim: If binom(n+D,D)>d^2, a nonzero rational polynomial p of degree at most D satisfies p(A)=0, so no postprocessing of that one response can test the whole vector space. The witness can be chosen with at most d^2+1 monomials and coefficient height O(d^2(log(d+1)+D(b+log(d+1)))) for integer tuple entries of b bits.
claims.limits: Not a lower bound for formula PIT; does not cover multiple queries, input-dependent white-box tuples, or dimensions meeting the displayed bound.

claims.interface: Supplied finite-state NC series realization F(w)=lambda A_w gamma over Q.
claims.claim: Its commutative image is lambda(I-sum_i x_i A_i)^(-1)gamma; zero-testing it reduces exactly to zero-testing the determinant of the (r+1)-dimensional bordered affine pencil.
claims.limits: This names a commutative determinant PIT consumer; it does not provide a deterministic algorithm for that consumer. L01 learner query/output costs remain separately charged.

claims.interface: Using a free NC polynomial/rational-formula PIT result as if it tested the commutative abelianization.
claims.claim: xy-yx abelianizes to zero but evaluates to diag(1,-1) at E12,E21; a free nonzero hit is compatible with commutative zero.
claims.limits: Does not rule out a different representation or quotient-aware algorithm.

source_limits: ECCC theorem page checked, not full proof. N68 full-response 2s acquisition and L01 learner are local source-derived records. N51 all-field list is supplied source-derived/unreviewed.
